title: Privacy Data viewable for Normal user
body:
Connected with #237 - When the setting 'Allow user to see member privacy data, e.g. Birth Year, Age.' is set to False user can see all the info under 'About Me' box. In 2.1.10

I would expect the 'About Me' information to be treated as privacy data.

Or maybe a tick box that allows this information to be shared under Personal Info and Contact Info on PersonEditor.php  

This is a critical issue for use due to privacy policy.
author: Participant 1
